    67	ParallelSortInfo parallel_merge_sort_impl(Values& values, int threads,
    68	                                          Less less=Less{}, Observer observer=Observer{}) {
    69	    static_assert(std::is_nothrow_invocable_r_v<bool,Less,Key,Key>);
    70	    static_assert(std::is_nothrow_copy_constructible_v<Less> && std::is_nothrow_copy_constructible_v<Observer>);
    71	    static_assert(noexcept(observer.task(0,0)) && noexcept(observer.merge(0,0,0)));
    72	    if (threads<1 || threads>64) throw std::invalid_argument("threads must be in [1,64]");
    73	    if (omp_get_level()>0) throw std::invalid_argument("nested OpenMP sorting is unsupported");
    74	    if (values.size()<2) return {};
    75	    Values buffer(values.size()); // All user allocation happens before tasks/mutation.
    76	    if (threads==1 || values.size()<parallel_merge_threshold) {
    77	        serial_range(values,buffer,0,values.size(),less,observer);
    78	        return {};
    79	    }

    81	    #pragma omp parallel num_threads(threads) default(none) shared(values,buffer,actual) firstprivate(less,observer)

    83	        #pragma omp single
    84	        {
    85	            actual=omp_get_num_threads();
    86	            task_range(values,buffer,0,values.size(),less,observer);
    87	        }
    88	    }
    89	    return {actual,true};
